title: Church Service and Ministry
definition: Church Service and Ministry is the shared labor of believers using God-given gifts to build up the body and serve others in love.
summary: Every believer is called to serve as part of Christ's body.
christFocus: Jesus Christ served His people and equips them to serve one another in His name.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church Service and Ministry teaches that Christ does not redeem people into isolation but into a gathered, accountable, worshiping, serving, and mission-shaped people. The Church belongs to Jesus, is formed by the Gospel, and is strengthened by the Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and Spirit-empowered service.

This doctrine helps believers see the Church as more than a place to attend. It is the household of God, the body of Christ, and a visible witness to the grace, holiness, unity, and truth of the Lord.

The specific emphasis here is every believer is called to serve as part of christ's body.. A healthy church life displays Christ's care for His people and His mission to the world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people treat church as optional, consumer-driven, or disconnected from discipleship. Church Service and Ministry calls believers back to Christ's design for His people, where worship, truth, love, accountability, service, and mission are held together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Participate in church life with humility and faithfulness. Let church service and ministry move you to serve, forgive, gather, pray, give, submit to Scripture, care for others, and help the body of Christ grow in love and maturity.
